questions.question: Which hook did you mean by "not working" — and what should I fix?

options.label: Fix prompt session grouping
options.description: Change the UserPromptSubmit hook so empty session_id falls back to 'unknown' (use jq 'if .session_id=="" or .session_id==null then "unknown" else .session_id end'), restoring per-session subfolders.

options.label: Fix plans-history capture
options.description: The Write-matcher approach can't catch plan files (they aren't written via the Write tool). I'd switch to a different event (e.g. a SessionStart/Stop sweep that copies new files from ~/.claude/plans/) so plans get archived again.

options.label: Both
options.description: Fix the session-grouping bug AND restore plans-history capture.

answers.Which hook did you mean by \"not working: the new prompts have been set empty
